notes:
Top-line: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating hosted first then Dedicated if economics work.

Key points / shorthand:
- Primary persona: Head of Product (Clara Ruiz) + Data Eng (Arun) + Platform Eng (Lena).
- Workloads: embeddings for semantic search (customer support kb + in-app help), nightly batch embedding jobs (Airflow), near-real-time index updates for top 100k docs.
- Targets: search median latency <= 60ms; 95th <= 150ms; indexing throughput target ~10M embeddings/week (batch), peak qps for search ~150 qps.
- Current POC: using hosted_api embeddings -> pushing vectors into Weaviate (self-hosted test cluster). Good quality but cost and throughput at 10M/week looks expensive on hosted pricing.
- Routing/fallback: want hosted for dev / initial prod, fall back to smaller model variants during peak. Interested in auto-routing by cost/latency.
- Security: must have SSO (SAML), SOC2, KMS integration for keys, audit logging, EU data residency option for EU customers. Legal: DPA + vendor risk assessment required.
- Integration notes: heavy reliance on Airflow for batch pipelines; ask about SDK for bulk_embed and streaming backpressure; need sample code for incremental reindexing and partial updates.
- POC observations: batch job runs stable but cost projected > committed Dedicated unless we get quantization / batching improvements. Also want Redis/KV cache suggestions for hot-queries.
- Quote from Product: "We need predictable unit economics for embeddings — if Dedicated drops cost per vector and we can keep latency SLOs, we'll convert."

Next steps in CRM: 1) Send Dedicated sizing + committed pricing by 2026-02-25. 2) Provide SOC2 evidence + KMS integration docs. 3) Hand off to finance for ARR approval.
